$comment: Fixed Job profiles (contracts/jobs/job.schema.json#/$defs/profile). Only reviewed profiles here can be launched; the launcher never accepts an arbitrary image, command or volume. local-check-v1 is the trusted qualification fixture of P05: it runs no candidate code and no model call. codegen-fixed-v1 and harness-wiring-dev-v1 are the P09 harness profiles and validator-fixture-v1, validator-source-v1 and validator-source-dev-v1 the P10/P0.8 validator profiles (the harness layout with the anvilkit-validator image: the fixed Hero only, a bound source under gVisor, and a bound source on the development foundation): their image digests are recorded from the reviewed builds, and the launcher additionally requires each profile to be enabled for its environment. codegen-team-dev-v1 is the P12 team profile (the anvilkit-codegen-team image: the validator image plus the trusted supervisor and the team package); it runs model-written code and stays DISABLED until the gVisor qualification. parser-docling-dev-v1 and parser-docling-v1 are the P15 parser profiles (the anvilkit-parser image, launched only by the Knowledge parser launcher in anvilkit-parsing); the gVisor one stays DISABLED until its qualification. P0.8: every profile carries its state (enabled, disabled, development), which every launcher enforces before the environment's allowlist, and a profile that executes a bound source declares bindsSource and candidateCode.

profiles.description: Fixed qualification fixture: computes the digest of a fixed input and reports a result manifest through the Pod termination message; the trusted observer verifies it against expectedResult.

Trusted harness with the fixed non-paid candidate task (P09b): the supervisor drops to the candidate UID, the observer verifies the output bytes, the finalizer submits through the access sidecar. Requires the gVisor RuntimeClass; DISABLED until its negative tests pass on the target runtime (G-04/G-05).

DEVELOPMENT_ONLY wiring fixture: the same trusted image, entrypoint, sidecar and fixed task as codegen-fixed-v1 on an unqualified runtime (no RuntimeClass). It verifies launcher templates, sidecar identity, the artifact flow and duplicate-Pod fencing on the development foundation; it qualifies no candidate isolation and is never enabled outside development.

P0.8: the fixed validator fixture (P10d, LocalCheck and fixtures): the anvilkit-validator image runs the complete-source, protected-build and certification chain on the fixed Hero component baked into it only (SSR and browser checks in the Pod's Chromium headless shell) and submits through the access sidecar. It never executes bound source (no bindsSource: the launcher and the Job refuse a source input). Harness layout without RuntimeClass; development only.

P0.8: the validator on a launch-bound source archive (generated or edited component source, P20 preview, release): candidate code, so the harness layout under the gVisor RuntimeClass with the access sidecar; the allocated identity in the launch envelope binds the certification. DISABLED until its negative tests pass on the target runtime (G-04).

P0.8 DEVELOPMENT_ONLY: validator-source-v1 on the development foundation's containerd runtime (no gVisor): the same image, layout and identity binding, labelled candidate code, so the complete bound-source path is exercised there; it qualifies no isolation and every launcher refuses it outside its development guard.

Bounded LangGraph/Pi coding team (P12): the trusted supervisor runs the team coordinator and launches the Pi coder as the candidate; the sealed source, the joint stage and the evidence are accepted through the access sidecar and the independent validator chain runs in the Pod. It executes model-written code: requires the gVisor RuntimeClass; DISABLED until its negative tests pass on the target runtime (G-04/G-05).

DEVELOPMENT_ONLY fixed Docling parser (P15): the anvilkit-parser image with the pinned layout weights, OCR, tables, remote services and plugins off; the trusted stager moves one input and one output through presigned URLs. Knowledge launches it in anvilkit-parsing on an unqualified runtime (no RuntimeClass); it qualifies no parser isolation and is never enabled outside development.

The same fixed Docling parser and stager under the gVisor RuntimeClass in the anvilkit-parsing namespace (SEC-10). DISABLED until its negative tests pass on the target runtime (malicious archives, path escapes, plugin/model downloads, egress) and ENV-04 measures its resources.
